        assignment.append({"id": pkt['id'], "range": r, "bank": q})

    stats = GlobalStats(points)
    for (rank, ordi) in points:
        stats.add(rank, ordi)

    observed = [0] * R
    departures = []
    tick = 0
    departed = 0
    idle = 0
    while departed < N:
        q = (sb + tick) % Q
        hp = heaps[q]
        if hp:
            rank, ordi, pid = hp[0]
            x, y, z = stats.query(rank, ordi)
            heapq.heappop(hp)
            stats.remove(rank, ordi)
            r = rank_info[ordi]
            if x > observed[r]:
                observed[r] = x
            departures.append({"t": tick, "bank": q, "id": pid,
                               "rank_error": x, "tie_overtakes": y,
                               "comparable": z})
            departed += 1
        else:
            idle += 1
        tick += 1

    ranges_out = []
    pref = 0
    for r in range(R):
        total_r = sum(n[r])
        pref += total_r
        if total_r == 0:
            B = 0
        else:
            first = pref - 1
            mx = max(n[r])
            second = (Q - 1) * (r * L + mx)
            B = first if first < second else second
        ranges_out.append({"counts": list(n[r]), "bound": B,
                           "observed": observed[r]})

    return {
        "assignment": assignment,
        "departures": departures,
        "ranges": ranges_out,
        "ticks": tick,
        "idle": idle,
    }
